title: The local gates run matches CI: the STE lint step, and the silent-undo test on git 2.43
why: Findings from the c125 lane (lanes run the gates lint before batching), Oct 27.
note: (1) gates.yml runs the STE lint as a uses: action, so ci-job --lint skips it; a bin/ste-changed run step in gates closes the gap. (2) lint/test_check_silent_undo.py errors in a cloud container with git 2.43 (test_a_gitlink_with_an_absent_commit_is_not_unknown, in check_silent_undo's absent); CI's result is unknown. Fix the cause or record a debt; red first in the container. Needs no answer. Port: no; it lives in claude-settings. Placed ahead of c124 (triage, Oct 27): a lane's local run should catch what CI catches, or c125 fails quietly.
